question: Does the R56 tree pass on a POSIX host, does the installed dist CLI run there, and is the byte account the same number it is on Windows?

host.kernel: Linux rjjRobert 6.6.114.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Dec  1 20:46:23 UTC 2025 x86_64 GNU/Linux
host.how: WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04; the tracked tree copied into the Linux filesystem and never run through /mnt/c
host.note: the `pnpm` shim on this box looks for pnpm.cjs, which is absent; a one-line wrapper points it at pnpm.mjs, so package.json scripts run unchanged. That is a harness fix, not a product claim.

installed_dist_cli.what: node packages/plugin/dist/cli.js verify on this host, against the fixture set the package ships

byte_account.note: measured by gate_size on this host, so the Linux and Windows accounts are compared rather than assumed equal

not_measured.npx: not re-run this round for the same reason.
not_measured.desktop_app: the desktop profile is not on this host; it stays on 0.4.15 until the publish.

limits: one Linux host (WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04) and one node build; this is not a distribution matrix
the `pnpm` wrapper is a harness detail: the Linux box has the pnpm.mjs file and not the pnpm.cjs the shim expects
